claims.text: The dataset was created by collecting voice clips validated by at least two users to ensure quality.
Samples were filtered by sentence lengths to reduce the portion of short sentences, making the evaluation set more challenging and realistic.
The dataset includes a diverse range of speakers and accents, with over 11,000 speakers contributing.
An additional evaluation corpus was collected from Tatoeba for several languages, adding to the dataset's richness.
